language.label: Language
language.title: Which language works best?
language.hint: The chosen language is used in the interface and in emails.

error.title: A little holiday pause
error.text: We can't reach the server right now. Please try again in a moment.
error.uncertainTitle: We're not sure the action was saved
error.uncertainText: Once you're back online, check the status in your account before submitting the form again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The address may have changed or contains a typo.

closed.title: The game is over
closed.text: Thank you for playing. The site is closed and participants' data has been deleted.

home.title: Secret Santa Bialto
home.text: A game for neighbours. Everything else is coming soon.

emails.ignore: If this wasn't you, just ignore this email.

verify.subject: Confirm your email
verify.title: Email confirmation
verify.body: To take part in the game, please confirm your email. It only takes a second.

reset.subject: Password reset
reset.title: Password reset
reset.body: We received a request for a new password. The link is valid for a short time.

application.subject: Application received
application.title: Application received
application.body: Your Secret Santa application has been received. We will write when the draw is done.

draw.subject: The draw is done
draw.title: The draw is done
draw.body: The pairs are set. Open your account to find out who you will look after. It is a secret, so keep it to yourself.

giftsOpen.subject: Gifts can be left now
giftsOpen.title: Gifts can be left now
giftsOpen.body: From today you can leave a gift at your recipient's building: in a locker or a mailbox. A guide for the amount is 10–15 €. Mark the gift in your account by the end of 31 December.

reminder.subject: Gift reminder
reminder.title: Your gift is not marked yet
reminder.body: If the gift is ready, leave it at your recipient's building and mark it in your account by the end of 31 December.

giftWaiting.subject: A gift is waiting for you
giftWaiting.title: A gift is waiting for you
giftWaiting.body: A gift has been left for you. Here is where to look.

reassigned.subject: Your recipient has changed
reassigned.title: Your recipient has changed
reassigned.body: Your previous recipient has left the game, and you have a new one. Details are in your account.

noReceiver.subject: No one left to give to
noReceiver.title: No one left to give to
noReceiver.body: Your recipient has left the game and there is no new one yet. Don't worry: your own gift will still arrive.

reveal.subject: Santas revealed
reveal.title: Santas revealed
reveal.body: It is 1 January and the Santas' names are open. Visit your account to see who looked after you and to check your guess.

consent.consent: I consent to the processing of my data and accept the rules of the game.
consent.age: I confirm that I am at least 14 years old.
consent.rules: Read the rules and data notice

register.title: Become a Santa
register.text: One account for you and your children. Taking part is free.

errors.password: The password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.consent: Consent to data processing and the rules of the game is required.
errors.age: Please confirm that you are at least 14. An adult registers younger children in their own account.
errors.closed: Sign-ups are closed, new accounts are not created.
errors.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalid: Something went wrong. Check the fields and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.errorText: Invalid email or password. If you forgot the password, reset it by email.

notice.denied: Sign-ups are closed: new accounts are not created. If you already have an account, sign in with the same email.
notice.failed: Could not sign in with Google. Please try again.

checkEmail.title: You have mail!
checkEmail.text: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open the email to take part in the game.
checkEmail.textNoEmail: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Open the email to take part in the game.
checkEmail.noMailText: Check your spam folder. You cannot take part until the email is confirmed.
checkEmail.wait: You can send it again in {seconds} s.

verified.title: Email confirmed
verified.text: You are all set. Sign in and fill in your profile so your Santa knows what to give you.

verifyExpired.title: This link no longer works
verifyExpired.text: It has expired or the email is already confirmed. You can ask for a new email.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.text: Enter the email of your account. We will send a link for a new password.
forgot.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
forgot.sentText: If an account with this email exists, we sent a link to change the password. Check your spam folder too.

reset.title: New password
reset.text: Choose a new password for your account.

errors.password: The password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.expired: The link no longer works. Request a new one.

reset.expiredText: A password link is valid for one hour and works once. You can request a new one.

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.text: Pick a language and give your consent. You only do this once.

errors.consent: Consent to data processing and the rules of the game is required.
errors.age: Please confirm that you are at least 14.
errors.invalid: Something went wrong. Check the fields and try again.
